display_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID of the LCD display.

*See also: [LCD Menu](https://esphome.io/components/display_menu/lcd_menu#a-debounced-gpio-push-button-is-used-to-click)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID used for code generation.

*See also: [LCD Menu](https://esphome.io/components/display_menu/lcd_menu#a-debounced-gpio-push-button-is-used-to-click)*

mark_back.docs:
**0-255**: Code of the character used to mark menu items going back one level. As the character set lacks a good looking back arrow, using a user defined character is advisable (use `8` to reference one at position `0` to avoid problems with zeros in a string). Defaults to `0x5e` (`^`  ).

*See also: [LCD Menu](https://esphome.io/components/display_menu/lcd_menu#a-debounced-gpio-push-button-is-used-to-click)*

mark_editing.docs:
**0-255**: Code of the character used to mark menu item editing mode. Defaults to `0x2a` (`*`  ).

*See also: [LCD Menu](https://esphome.io/components/display_menu/lcd_menu#a-debounced-gpio-push-button-is-used-to-click)*

mark_selected.docs:
**0-255**: Code of the character used to mark menu item selected. Defaults to `0x3e` (`>`  ).

*See also: [LCD Menu](https://esphome.io/components/display_menu/lcd_menu#a-debounced-gpio-push-button-is-used-to-click)*

mark_submenu.docs:
**0-255**: Code of the character used to mark menu item leading to a submenu. Defaults to `0x7e` (a right arrow).

*See also: [LCD Menu](https://esphome.io/components/display_menu/lcd_menu#a-debounced-gpio-push-button-is-used-to-click)*
